product_metadata.title: Kassatex Firenze Collection Towel Set, 3 Piece Set - White
features: Firenze collection towels are delightfully soft and super absorbent
Towels are dyed for added color fastness and styled with a classical elegance
Made from 100% Long Staple Combed Turkish Cotton. Made in Turkey
Care Instructions: Machine wash warm, tumble dry medium, avoid bleach and do not use fabric softener
Each set includes 1 Bath Towel 30" x 54", 1 Hand Towel 18" x 28", and 1 Wash Towel 13" x 13"
description: Art and design collide. These piece dye Jacquard designed towels are made of 100% Long Staple Combed Turkish Cotton offering a delightful softness and absorbency. Manufactured in the finest Turkish cotton and piece dyed for added color fastness, the classical elegance of this collection will last forever. Plush 650gsm. Made in Turkey. Bath Towel 30 x 54, Hand Towel 18 x 28, Wash Towel 13 x 13.
